# Python packages for maiOs

The maiOs Python archive includes these pure-Python wheels:

- Django 5.2.19
- asgiref 3.13.0
- sqlparse 0.6.1

They are distributed by the Django Software Foundation and sqlparse project.
The build keeps the wheel files as downloaded and copies package contents into
`python311.zip`; package metadata is omitted from the runtime archive.
